description: Copa Airlines ConnectMiles miles, qualifying miles and qualifying segments for Copa Airlines flights. Miles = distance x fare family % (Economy Basic 50, Economy Classic 100, Economy Full and Business Promo 175, Business Full 300), at least 500 per flight; qualifying miles are the same; booking classes G, I, N, P, X and Z earn nothing (noearn Y). PreferMember bonus on miles only (Silver 25%, Gold 50%, Platinum 75%, Presidential 100%). Progress toward Silver, Gold, Platinum and Presidential by qualifying miles (20,000 / 40,000 / 70,000 / 90,000) or segments in a calendar year; qm and qs are the totals so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Copa Airlines's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fam.description: Fare family. EB = Economy Basic (Economy, 50%); EC = Economy Classic or Classic Flex (Economy, 100%); EF = Economy Full (Economy, 175%); BP = Business Promo (Business, 175%); BF = Business Full (Business, 300%). The fare family on your Copa Airlines ticket. Economy Basic earns half the distance; Business Full earns triple.

noearn.description: Is your booking class G, I, N, P, X or Z?. N = No; Y = Yes (earns nothing). Copa Airlines says these classes earn no miles or segments. Choose No if you do not know.

qm.description: Qualifying miles you have this calendar year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next PreferMember status.

qs.description: Qualifying segments you have this calendar year (optional). Economy Basic counts half a segment.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your PreferProgram status. NO = Not a PreferMember; SI = Silver (+25%); GO = Gold (+50%); PL = Platinum (+75%); PR = Presidential (+100%). The PreferMember bonus is paid on award miles for Copa Airlines flights; it does not count toward status.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
